messages:
tania: FYI finance found ~25 invoices where customer credits didn't show up in NetSuite after yesterday's midnight batch. timing cluster ~2026-02-14 23:50..00:20 UTC. filing here so we can track.

ev an: Any sign it's a Stripe -> webhook -> processor gap, or an apply-job failure?

tania: Stripe shows refunds/credit objects present. Webhook logs show delivered events but processor logged 'suppressed' for a subset.

recon-bot: [auto] mismatch-alert count=24 window=2026-02-14T23:45..2026-02-15T00:25 sample_invoices=[in_8Zz12,in_5Qwe9]

ev an: Do we have the suppressor config from the recent deploy? IIRC we tightened the dedupe window last week.

lucy: Pasting the suppressor snippet from deploy v2.3.6: ```suppression: enabled=true window_ms=60000 lookback_ms=120000 key_fields=["idempotency","event_type"]```

tania: That looks like 60s window. These events show 'delivered_at' timestamps 3-4m after the Stripe event's created_at. Likely delayed deliveries + a strict window caused legit events to be suppressed and not forwarded to the 'apply' worker.

evan: Where are suppressed payloads landing? We need to reprocess them, but safely (idempotent).

lucy: s3 path: s3://redwood-prod/webhooks/suppressed/2026-02-14/ .. about 312 files. I filtered credit/refund types -> 28 payloads that map to the flagged invoices.

ops-bot: [auto] suppression-toggle suggested: set suppression.enabled=false for emergency replay.

ev an: Let's not kill suppression for >30m. Plan: toggle false, run replay for the specific day, then re-enable with a config fix. Who owns replay tooling?

tania: I'm on it. Proposed steps: 1) export suppressed payloads -> ./tmp/suppressed-feb14/ 2) run replay tool with --bypass-suppress 3) run reconciliation dry-run to ensure no double-applies.

lucy: Command I used in staging successfully (dry-run): ```aws s3 sync s3://redwood-prod/webhooks/suppressed/2026-02-14/ ./suppressed-feb14/ && python tools/replay.py --ids-file ./suppressed-feb14/credit_ids.txt --bypass-suppress --dry-run```

evan: OK. If dry-run looks good, ops can flip suppression off for 10m and we run actual replay. Also add extra logging in replay to annotate originals so finance can trace changes.

tania: Dry-run result: 28 ids processed -> 26 would apply credits; 2 flagged as already-applied (likely duplicates). CSV generated: ./dryrun_results/feb14_replay.csv

ops-bot: [auto] replay-job queued job_id=job_9911 queued_by=tania eta=2026-02-15T01:05:00Z

ops-bot: [auto] suppression.enabled toggled=false by ops at 2026-02-15T01:03:10Z

ops-bot: [auto] replay-job started job_id=job_9911 status=running

lucy: Running replay now. Will monitor for errors and NetSuite downstream apply confirmations.

evan: After replay completes, please attach the NetSuite apply IDs and reconcile amounts with finance. For any non-trivial changes, we'll run manual approval before writing to ledgers.

tania: Replay finished. Results: 26 credits applied to NetSuite (ns_apply_ids in csv). 2 skipped (already present). No failures. Uploading ./replay_results/feb14_applies.csv

recon-bot: [auto] reconcile-check passed=26 failed=0 duplicates_skipped=2 total_checked=28

lucy: Re-enable suppression but with updated tolerance: new config proposal: window_ms=180000 lookback_ms=420000 include_field=event_created_at_tolerant. I'll open PR to adjust parsing and normalize to event_created_at (not delivery time).

evan: Also add a metric for webhook_delivery_delay and an alert if >2m for >0.1% of events. That would've caught the delayed delivery pattern earlier.

tania: Finance confirmed balances reconcile. They'll notify affected customers with a short note. I'll paste the CSV to #support for the message template.

ops-bot: [auto] suppression.enabled toggled=true by ops at 2026-02-15T01:40:30Z

lucy: Follow-ups: (1) PR to change suppressor to use event_created_at tolerance (2) add idempotency double-check read that checks both delivery_ts and created_ts (3) add replay capability docs for finance-runbooks.

ev an: Thanks. Good catch and clean replay. Let's add a postmortem note and an owner for the suppressor logic.

tania: I'll draft the postmortem and link the replay artifacts. Closing thread once PM reviewed the comms. :checkered_flag:
